selection: Publicly downloadable, genuinely different revisions of the same real document; no regenerated or mutated substitutes.

Exclude every series previously acquired, inspected, or compared during this issue, including all main-corpus series, JLS, structured-field RFCs, and Web Linking RFCs, regardless of alternate producer or rendering.
Prefer documents from different publishers or producer families. Record this diversity; it does not replace the two-series requirement.
Choose bounded, physically reviewable changed passages using source documents only. No comparison output may influence selection, annotation, or selector validation.
Record every acquisition attempt and selector failure. Replace invalid trials before comparison output inspection, retaining reasons and provenance.
annotation_freeze: Record URLs, acquisition time, byte sizes, SHA-256 hashes, metadata, page numbers, reviewed old/new passages, exact operation and source-backed changed ranges, and reviewed unchanged context.
Inspect rendered page images and independently extracted text; bind selectors to retained source positions and verify uniqueness over the entire selected source view.
Freeze annotations and selector hashes before invoking any comparison route. Never provide expected IDs or annotation boundaries to production comparison.

execution.configuration: Frozen executable defaults, limit scale 1.0, 4194304 KiB address-space limit and 1200-second deadline; no post-output limit changes.
execution.report: Preserve every route result, failure, per-side/channel coverage and search status; score reviewed text scopes separately from document completeness.

acceptance: Recover each predeclared whole change as an established operation with exact old/new source locations. Token-only gains, inferred matches, and assembled fragments do not pass.
Zero false positives in reviewed unchanged context.
Each unchanged-input control has zero established changes and complete coverage for the claimed scope and channels; partial coverage cannot be reported as a complete/no-change pass.
Publish all selected channels and distinguish scoped text acceptance from wider document completeness.
Any implementation fix informed by a holdout consumes its series. Retain failed results as development evidence, freeze a new implementation, and select new series.
